scope: 15 real public research objectives. MOCK preflight and source capture alone never count as accepted research outcomes.
browser_status: NOT_RUN: unchanged normal Chromium sandbox blocker
steps: Test ordinary conversation and durable controls before any browser acceptance run.
Muse reviews/merges the source branch and generates/applies the forward migration through the supported CLI; no deployment occurs from this contribution.
Use existing authorized Upmore identity and own thread; send the exact conversation_command with a unique turn_key including the case ID. Retain reviewed source SHA and immutable manifest SHA.
Read back committed queued intent before running the existing owned worker with the explicitly approved origins. Keep its normal sandbox, TLS checks and fresh unauthenticated research context.

After the worker finishes, ask Research status <intent_id>. Retain task/intent/turn correlation, session and navigation records, source/body/screenshot hashes, timestamp and persisted artifact readback.

Inspect source links and request an explicit additional public read if a detail page is required; each follow-up gets its own correlated intent. No automatic link click, gate consent, login, form fill or application.
A reviewer must verify each claimed answer against captured source. evidence_ready only proves a capture; objectiveStatus requires_review is never an accepted answer. Missing facts stay unknown.

Mark a case ACCEPTED only when its concrete objective is satisfied by genuine public source evidence and user-facing answer. Gated, dynamic/JS-only, redirected, unavailable or incomplete cases remain BLOCKED/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Never replace them with fixtures.
